name: Speed Lines
description: Comic-style speed lines shoot in from the edges of the frame toward a focus point as the first clip punches in; at the peak it cuts to the second clip, which settles back as the lines retract to the edges. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Point the lines converge to (0..1, y down)

params.name: density
params.description: Number of lines around the focus point

params.name: focus
params.description: Size of the clear area around the focus point at the peak, from almost nothing to the whole frame

params.name: zoom
params.description: How much the clips punch in toward the focus point
